title: Verify text-search semantics in the existing Open Food Facts SDK fix
research_next_step: Inspect pinned PR #504 setup/dependencies, CI, remaining AI/license rules and test network behavior; run the unchanged relevant SDK tests in an isolated environment, then trace the server-side query contract. Preserve the existing author and do not infer full-text support from mocked HTTP success.
problem: The README text_search example is reported to fail after CGI authentication changes. Existing PR #504 substitutes /api/v2/search while retaining search_terms, but official v2 docs say full-text search is unsupported. Its changed tests mock fixed results and cannot establish server search semantics.
humanitarian_relevance: Correct product retrieval supports open food-information tools and research. This is a public-benefit pathway, not a demonstrated health or humanitarian-outcome improvement.

evidence.claim: Issue #496 reports HTTP 503 from the documented text_search example; a maintainer says the CGI endpoint now requires authentication.

Read both changed-file diffs at PR head 970a7290a8a5869de8f5784324c166212fdd15ca: the method changes to /api/v2/search and retains search_terms; the tests change URL mocks and return predetermined products. No target test was run.
Current official v2 search documentation explicitly states that full-text requests are unsupported. This is documented contract evidence, not a live query result.

code_surface: src/openfoodfacts/api.py ProductResource.text_search and tests/unit/test_api.py in existing PR #504 at 970a7290a8a5869de8f5784324c166212fdd15ca.
proposed_change: First verify the documented mismatch and support the existing author with a semantic regression strategy. Agree the supported search/authentication and compatibility contract before changing the SDK. No replacement PR or credential-in-URL workaround.
tests: Both changed diffs inspected; mocked return values do not prove query-dependent server behavior. Proposed verification uses matching/nonmatching terms and pagination controls after setup/policy review. No SDK or live API test executed.
environment: Read-only public source and documentation retrieval only. No clone, installation, target imports, live product query, credentials or production writes.
maintainer: Existing PR author arybhatt4533. No Humanifest coordination sent, no human PR reviews returned in the inspected endpoint, and no confirmed scope or reviewer commitment for this contribution.
risks: Returning HTTP success from an endpoint is insufficient if full-text semantics differ. Authentication and response compatibility need an explicit contract. Runtime, policy, license, deployment and realized benefit remain unverified. Avoid duplicating #507 or PR #504.
priority_rationale: An existing patch has a specific documented search-contract mismatch that narrow mocked tests do not validate. A focused verification contribution may prevent a misleading fix while reducing review burden; acceptance and realized impact remain unknown.
